message: New authoritative IAM reference now available: /tmp/cloud-api-reference/aws-cloudformation-authorization.json SHA256 5f5214d42df63c5d04964ae9086788bc060bd09d52c92a75ba51f6914385e83c (74,566 bytes), acquisition JSON alongside. Source is AWS's machine-readable service reference https://servicereference.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/v1/cloudformation/cloudformation.json, discovered from its official service-list.json; not the generic redirected HTML page, which was unusable. Confirmed: CreateChangeSet supports cloudformation:RoleArn, cloudformation:ChangeSetName, TemplateUrl etc; ExecuteChangeSet supports ChangeSetName but NOT RoleArn. Both action resource types are stack, not a guessed changeSet resource ARN. Operations list narrow PassRole with iam:PassedToService=cloudformation.amazonaws.com for creation and possible TagResource/UntagResource dependent actions. Use this actual native schema for concrete least-privilege examples and role binding: explicit expected role + native CreateChangeSet RoleArn condition prevents omitted-role fallback, whereas an ExecuteChangeSet RoleArn condition would be unsupported. Read exact applicable entries before implementing; preserve/admit additional source evidence without rewriting the initial manifest. Research only, no cloud action or quality verdict.
